description: An addition adds new space, while a remodel updates existing space. We help you decide which best meets your needs for functionality and value.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a home addition and a remodel, and which is right for me?

acceptedAnswer.text: A home addition involves expanding the footprint of your home or adding a new story, creating entirely new space. A remodel, conversely, modifies existing space without increasing the overall square footage. Choosing between them depends on your needs; an addition provides more living area, while a remodel updates existing rooms. Frasheski Construction can help you evaluate if an addition, like expanding a kitchen or adding an ADU, or a remodel best meets your objectives for enhancing your home's functionality and value in the East Bay.
